prompt: 3 prospects a analyser pour du link building sur la page https://schoolswp.com/comparatifs/meilleurs-crm-wordpress/ — developer.wordpress.org, blogdumoderateur, kinsta

assertions.text: All prospect URLs are scraped individually via Firecrawl
Each prospect receives its own distinct analysis (not copy-pasted)
Qualifications vary across prospects based on actual fit (not all rated the same)
A batch summary file is generated with qualification overview
Each prospect follows the complete output format from the skill
Language adapts per prospect (English for wordpress.org, French for FR prospects)
